name: bash
description: Execute a shell command in the project directory

name: read_file
description: Read the contents of a file

file_path.description: Path to the file (relative to project or absolute)

name: write_file
description: Write content to a file (creates parent directories)

file_path.description: Path to the file (relative to project or absolute)

content.description: Content to write to the file

name: edit_file
description: Edit a file by replacing old_string with new_string

file_path.description: Path to the file to edit

old_string.description: The exact string to find and replace

new_string.description: The string to replace it with

name: glob
description: Find files matching a glob pattern

name: grep
description: Search for a pattern in files using ripgrep or grep

name: ask_user
description: Ask the user a question with any number of options. Use this EXTENSIVELY when unsure. Perfect for clarifying requirements, choosing between approaches, or gathering project specifications.

question.description: The question to ask (clear, specific, ends with ?)

options.description: Options for the user to choose from. First 4 can be selected with face buttons (A/B/X/Y), rest via d-pad navigation.

multi_select.description: If true, user can select multiple options
